steps.content: Framed by abstract paintings, the stage exudes a cold and somber aura. However, at its heart, a dancer stands ablaze with warm colors, utterly incongruous yet commanding the attention of every onlooker in the space.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: Well, well, is she also up for auction? Take a look at this, Parfait. The Outlands' creativity grows more brazen by the minute.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: ...Isn't it just part of the show? I surely don't see any "human exhibits" listed on the auction catalog.

steps.speaker: Fraser Ambassador
steps.content: This is a little surprise from Mr. Campbell.

steps.speaker: Fraser Ambassador
steps.content: As long as she catches your interest, she has value. And valuable things naturally find their way to market.
[A figure in the shadows]
Below the stage, you stand among the crowd.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Chief, I notice your heightened attention. Do you have any thoughts?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I don't know.
You find it hard to put the feeling into words. The figure on stage resembles the artworks behind her—eerily surreal, as if stitched together from fragments: some cold, others warm.
She radiates a familiar distortion, yet remains jarringly alien, both repelling and captivating. It's like...

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: It's like seeing a lone flower blooming in the rain... in the middle of a cold cemetery.
[Small CG]

steps.speaker: Fraser Ambassador
steps.content: Next up, we have a special performance for you—an improvised dance piece inspired by Lamentur.
[Big CG] Scene dims

steps.speaker: Fraser Ambassador
steps.content: Presenting the nomadic blade dancer—<color=#fb9259>Jasmine</color>.
She lowers her gaze, her first movements deliberate and slow as if designed to pull every eye toward her. This is someone who knows how to wield attention like a blade.

steps.speaker: Audience
steps.content: Hey, this one's pretty good. Completely different from what you see in DisCity. Is that body paint on her? Hot. She'll definitely fetch a high price.

steps.speaker: Audience
steps.content: Shame about the stage though. Such a downer with all that gloom. Why couldn't they go for something like that fancy painting at Parfait's dinner party—what was the name again...? The Golden City! Right! Now that style would've lit the place up properly.

steps.speaker: Audience
steps.content: Hey look, her lips are moving. You think she's singing? Haha, hope it's not some Outland dialect.
Jasmine's voice is lost to the crowd, yet theirs reach her with eerie clarity—countless murmurs threading through her mind like whispers on an invisible tide.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Is this painting really that gloomy? I actually quite like it.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: It's just like what I've dreamed of over and over. And exactly like the celebration I remember. All those forgotten faces, forgotten moments... they're all coming back to me now.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: But I must behave... No slicing, no cutting. I promised Sibilla, and her friend might be here too.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: That reminds me... someone else made a request...
Slowly, she lifts her blades and performs a crowd-pleasing move intended to elicit applause, all the while scanning the audience until her gaze settles on a long-haired blond man below the stage.
Adelaide Campbell offers her a smile.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Hmph, fox. I remember what you said...

A sharp signal cracks through the air—instantly, she shifts her rhythm. Ropes coil tight around her calves as she's wrenched upside down, then released. Momentum arcs her body backward, and in one fluid motion, the blades in her hands carve straight through the massive painting behind.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: Woops... Parfait, looks like your precious collectible is gone.

Amid gasps and cheers, the masterpiece Lamentur is rent into a dozen fragments. Shards of fabric spiral through the air, stealing the audience's gaze. And in that breath of distraction, the woman vanishes. Then, a shout—

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: ${PlayerName}!
A streak of pink light slithers through the crowd, serpentine, flaring ever brighter in your vision. Instinctively, you shove aside nearby spectators and plainclothes guards.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Chief?!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Stay away from her!
Her gaze lifts, sharp with cold, predatory intent—the kind that would easily shatter an ordinary person's will. At this distance, you finally confirm what you have vaguely sensed all along—
